description: The bar chart illustrates self-report accuracy for “Instilled Preferences” across two model variants and three experimental conditions. The horizontal axis contains the model categories “GPT-4o” and “GPT-4o-mini,” arranged left to right, with grouped bars within each model. The vertical axis is labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” and uses a linear scale from 0.00 to 1.00, with regularly spaced tick labels at approximately 0.25 intervals (0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.00). Each model group contains three bars corresponding to the legend: Control (light gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark purple), and each bar includes a vertical error bar. For GPT-4o, the Control bar is light gray at roughly 0.10, the Before Introspection Training bar is light blue at roughly 0.55, and the After Introspection Training bar is dark purple at roughly 0.74. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is light gray at approximately 0.00 (near the baseline), the Before Introspection Training bar is light blue at roughly 0.50, and the After Introspection Training bar is dark purple at roughly 0.75. The bars are not presented as a sorted ranking; they are grouped by model with a consistent left-to-right condition order, and no bars appear specially emphasized beyond the distinct colors and the presence of error bars.
